race.comment: Looks a competitive contest. The well-related BARCELO (2) (half to G1 winner Kukeracha) placed over this course and distance last time out and looks to be building up to another victory. Gets the reliable Waller/Maloney combination and should be right there at the business end. BON RIVIERE (3) hasn't been too far away of late and looks the runner in this field with the most upside. Can play a role in the finish. SPOT THE AUSSIE (10) strips fitter second-up from the break and must be respected out of the Vandyke barn. Top-three credentials on best figures. DEVINE SQUIRE (6) has placed three of four around this circuit and is more than capable enough on his day. In the mix. TASSORATI (12) is a last-start winner who shouldn't be slept on.
